Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka on the other hand, started off really well but could not continue to build the pressure. Perera and Dananjaya were quite expensive. Gamage also, took some beating towards the end. Vandersay and Lakmal both bowled well for them but were not supported by the rest. The visitors have a stiff task ahead of them and they will have to break their own record of the highest run chase on this ground. They will have to bat out of their skins on a wicket which is providing some assistance to the bowlers. The hosts would back themselves as they have a brilliant bowling line-up. Join us for the chase in a while.

A very good batting performance by Pakistan and they will be the happier side heading into the break after being put into bat. They lost Shehzad early but Babar Azam who scored a brilliant ton played the anchoring role. He was supported well by Hafeez and Zaman but his 139-run stand with Malik which came in less than a run-a-ball was the highlight of the innings.
Full outside off, Ali charges down but misses. A dot ball to end the over! PAKISTAN FINISH ON 292/6!

FOUR! Dananjaya, what are you doing! This is a time to keep calm and not lose it! Perera spears it very full outside off, Ali slices it towards sweeper cover. Akila rushes to the ball but after bouncing the ball spins away and goes for a boundary. He's done in by his own trick here - spin of the ball!
Slower delivery around middle, pushed down to long off for a run. Wasim wanted a second but had to settle for one.
SIX! Humongous! Smoked! Timely blow! Perera hurls it on a length around middle, Wasim uses all his power and hits it over long on for a maximum. Pakistan wouldn't mind more of these!
Another full ball outside off, flat-batted through cover-point for a brace.
Perera bowls this full and wide with a slingy action, Wasim looks to flay at that but misses.
Full toss around middle, Ali gets an inside edge off his pads towards mid-wicket. The batsmen run a couple.
FOUR! Ali can use the long handle to good effect, proved! It was bowled on a length around off and middle, Ali pulls it in front of square on the leg side and helps himself to a boundary.
Fuller around off, driven through covers for a run.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. They pick up a single.
WIDE! Fired down the leg side, Wasim misses the flick. But they collect a bye even as the keeper collects and throws it.
The next man in is Hasan Ali.

OUT! Pakistan have switched on their self-destruction mode it seems! At the business end of the innings, they are losing wickets quickly to be devoid of any momentum. It is bowled around middle and off, Azam looks to smash it out of the park but gets it high off the bat. The long on fielder, Dananjaya, settles under it and takes it. End of a terrific knock here at a vital time for his side, the coach applauds the effort too!

Lakmal lands it around middle and leg, Azam turns it off his hips through square leg. They hare back for the second even as the throw is fired at the keeper's end. Dickwella whips off the bails and asks the questions. The third umpire is referred to. Replays show that the batsman is well in.
They have gone upstairs to check for a run out at the striker's end against Babar Azam. He looks pretty confident.
Azam drives it to long on for a run.
Imad Wasim is the next man in.

OUT! The skipper's gone now! Thank you for coming, says Perera! He hurls a slower delivery around off, Ahmed looks to slog it away. Gets a top edge that goes to the fielder, Tharanga, at point. The Pakistan coach is seen fuming there as that wicket fell. Sri Lanka would be happy to see the back of a potential good hitting batsman cheaply!

That's ODI hundred no. 6 for Azam! What a responsible knock this has been. He took his time to settle in before going on a run-scoring spree. Take a bow, young man. Ball - around middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Ahmed gets off the mark y working this delivery through square leg.
Landed around middle, pushed defensively back.
Azam works it through mid-wicket for a run that takes him to 99!
Skipper Sarfraz Ahmed is seen walking out to bat.

OUT! Dangerman Malik has to depart! Sri Lanka are happy as the end overs damage could potentially be less. Lakmal lands it on a length around off, Malik stays deep and looks to smash it over deep mid-wicket. The ball travels straight to Dananjaya in the deep there. Lakmal thanks the almighty. Pakistan lose a wicket at the wrong time here! Nevertheless, it has been a very good innings by Malik.
Hurled on the pads, flicked away to fine leg for a run.
Very full around middle and leg, Malik digs it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, driven towards covers. The fielder there makes a half-stop and concedes a run.
Malik flicks it through mid-wicket and crosses over to the other end.
Length delivery in line of the stumps, turned through mid-wicket for a run.
Suranga Lakmal is back to bowl.

Dinesh Chandimal has hurt his right knee in the fielding effort on the last delivery. The physio is on the field to tend him and the Test skipper is limping off the field. Chamara Kapugedera is the substitute on for him.

Another slower ball, driven down the ground by Malik. Chandimal hares to his left, puts in the dive and saves a couple of runs for his side. As he did so, his right knee got stuck on the field and he is hurt in the process. He looks to be in some pain.

FOUR! Technically it is a drop. Perera bowls a slower delivery around middle, Malik gets down on one knee and looks to go over the leg side. Ends up offering a skier towards deep square leg where Siriwardana completely misjudges it. Fails to get a hand to it and concedes a boundary.
Landed outside off, driven through covers for a brace.
SIX! Magnificent Malik! Perera overdoes his leg cutting slower delivery thing and bowls it wide of off stump. Malik reaches out to it and smokes it over extra covers for a biggie.
Full ball around middle and leg, wristed down to mid-wicket for a run.
Malik belts this low full toss straight to the fielder at square leg for a run.
Now he pushes it through covers for a run to retain strike.

FOUR! This is why Malik is such a dangerous batsman! Gamage spears a very full delivery on the pads, Malik nudges it through the backward square leg region for a boundary. The man at fine leg ran to his left but in vain.
WIDE! Lahiru spears it down the leg side in a bid to cramp Malik up for room. Wide given.
FOUR! That's a gift for the well-set Malik! Gamage lands it on a harmless length around off and middle, Malik stays in the crease and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Gamage hurls it very full around off and middle, Malik digs it out towards mid-wicket. What's more, he runs quickly to complete a couple.
Full in line of the stumps, driven down the ground the ground for a run.
On a length around off, punched through coves for a run.
Lahiru Gamage is back on!
Full ball on the stumps, Malik drives it down to long on for a run.
Off pace delivery outside off, Azam punches it through the off side for a run.
A low full toss on leg stump, Azam flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace. Brilliant running again, they have ran the Lankans ragged.
100-run stand between the two it has come up only in 94 balls a vital one for Pakistan. Perera bowls it full outside off, Malik drives it through mid off for a run.
Slower ball outside off, Malik tries to cut it but misses. He went too hard at the ball there.

Fifty up for Malik, his 40th in ODIs. A brilliant knock, he has been positive from the time he has come out. Perera goes wide of the crease and angles it into the pads. Malik flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace. Pakistan need him to finish strongly.
Slower ball on leg stump. Malik flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run. He is into the 90s now.
Very full on middle, Malik drives it down to long on for a run.
Short ball on middle, Azam pulls it through the leg side for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Shorter in length again on middle, Azam pulls it towards mid-wicket. They run one and set off for the second. The fielder is quick to the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. The players appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show Malik has made his crease. He is very quick between the wickets.
A direct hit! Well they are always close. They have gone upstairs to check for a run out at the non-striker's end.
Suranga Lakmal is into the attack! Change of ends for him.
Shorter in length outside off, Azam cuts it towards point for a run.
Flicks it through the leg side for a run.

Almost kicked it on! Very slow and shorter in length. Malik rocks back and tries to pull but gets a bottom edge onto his pads. As he swiveled, he almost kicked the ball back onto the stump. Very close!
Slower but on the shorter side. Azam pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.

Short and very slow on middle. Azam swivels inside the crease and pulls it towards short fine leg. Lakmal there dives but lets the ball through him. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and saves a run for his side.
Thisara Perera is back into the attack.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.

Azam is lucky again! He dances down the track. Vandersay sees it and pulls his length back. The ball turns away a touch. Azam is beaten on the defense but to his luck the ball hits the pads and deflects away from the keeper's gloves. It rolls down towards third man for two leg byes.
Fuller in length on middle, Azam drives it back towards the bowler who dives to his right and makes a good stop.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Taps it towards covers for a run.
Floats it up on middle, Azam gets a soft leading edge towards covers for a run.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled, Sri Lanka can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the circle.
Shorter in length on off, sits up to be hit. Azam pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tries to bowl a yorker but ends up bowling a full toss on middle. Azam flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Full and outside off, very close to being called a wide. Azam lets it through to the keeper as the thought it was one. The umpire might have not given it as Babar had shuffled across.
Good length outside off, Malik opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a run.
FOUR! This time he puts it away! Full and outside off, easy for Malik. He hits it uppishly but in the gap between extra cover and mid off for a boundary. Sania Mirza in the crowd liked that.
Full toss outside off, Malik times it towards point. Vandersay there dives and makes a good stop. Malik will be disappointed he did not get that away.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Malik drives it to long on to change strike.
Uses his feet and gets to the pitch of the ball, he drives it firmly to long off for a run.
Flatter on middle, Azam defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! A gift for Azam, a full toss but it still has to be put away. Azam goes down on one knee and sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary. No fielder in the deep there.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tosses it up on off, Malik drives it down to long off for a run.
Jeffrey Vandersay is back into the attack.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Full toss outside off, Azam guides it to third man for a run.
Shorter in length outside off, Malik cuts it through point for a run.
Good length ball outside off, Azam plays it down to third man for a run.

FOUR! BANG! That was right in the arc, just where Azam wanted. Fullish in length on middle, Azam shuffles across and whips it over mid-wicket. The umpires go upstairs to check whether it is a maximum or a boundary. Replays show it has just bounced inside. A boundary is signaled.
Lands it on a length around off. Azam pushes it towards point. He wanted a single but then decides against it as the fielder was quick to the ball.
Lahiru Gamage is back into the attack.
Fullish length this time on middle. Malik drives it to mid on. A good over by Lakmal.
Goes for the surprise short ball on off, Azam is ready for it, he pulls it off the middle but straight to the fielder at deep square leg. A run taken.
Angles it onto the pads, a slower one. Malik waits for it and flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Good length outside off, Azam guides it down to third man for a run. A shot which has brought him a lot of runs.
Shorter in length around off, not very short. Azam goes for the pull but mistimes it to mid-wicket.
On a length outside off. Malik has all the time in the world to open the face of the bat and guide it down to third man for a run.
Drags his length back on off, Malik pushes it through the off side for a run. 1000 runs in ODIs for Malik in UAE. 8 runs from the over, a good one for Pakistan.

Flatter and quicker on off, Malik off the back foot pushes it through covers. Some good running by the batsmen help them take two. This also brings up the 50-run stand between the two, a really good one.
He has played this shot with so much effect. Jeffrey bowls it shorter in length outside off, gives Malik room. He cashes in and guides it late towards short third man for a couple.
Flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Edged but no fielder there! Shorter in length outside, spins away further. Azam tries to force it through the off side off the back foot but gets an outside edge through short third man for a brace.
Floats it full outside off, Azam with the spin drives it to the man at covers.
Jeffrey Vandersay is into the attack.

Drinks have been brought in! Sri Lanka would be desperate to stop Pakistan's ascendancy from here, as generally wickets in hand and set batsmen at the crease result in a tall score towards the end. While the hosts would hope for just that, the visitors would have their thinking caps on to prevent that from happening.
This ball is punched towards mid on for a run.
Chin music for Azam! Lakmal bangs it in short around off, Azam ducks under that to let it go.
Lakmal lands it outside off, Malik opens the face of his bat and collects a single towards third man.

The two skippers chatting! ODI skipper Tharanga is seen talking with the Test skipper Chandimal. They surely need to break this stand as both the batters are looking good. That's what it might have been about.
Now Azam works this down the leg side for a run.
Lakmal lands it on a length around middle and leg, Azam looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Length ball around off, punched towards covers.
Suranga Lakmal is back for another spell. Sri Lanka need to breakthrough soon.
Fuller outside off, Malik gets down on one knee and dabs it through short third man. Gets a couple.
Akila serves this in line of the stumps, Malik turns it through mid-wicket and hares back for the second.
Finds the cover fielder with that shot.
Azam plays it to long on for a single.
Knocked through covers for a single.

SIX! 100th six in ODIs for Malik! Arnold quips on-air that it is in the air and would be caught, but in the stands by someone in the crowd! Dananjaya is generous in tossing that up, Malik charges down the track and thumps it over long on for a humongous hit. Seems that it has hit someone in the crowd.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Floated outside off, Malik gets an outside edge through short third man for a brace.
This ball is punched down to long off for a run.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Now he collects a run through covers.

FOUR! And now the confidence is seeping through. He dispatched that with ease and grace! Siriwardana served it short, Azam goes back and pulls it way over mid-wicket this time. Dananjaya from long on runs to his right and puts in the dive but is unable to prevent the boundary.
This ball is turned away to mid-wicket.
Tossed up in line of off and middle, Malik prods forward and blocks.
This ball is played to the point region.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Azam works it through square leg for a run.

WIDE! Big appeal again from Dickwella, turned down again. Wide signaled again! Dananjaya floats it around middle and leg, the ball spins down the leg side. Azam looks to swat it away but misses. The keeper again appeals but it is turned down. Snicko this time shows that there indeed was a feather! Hush! How costly is that waste of review earlier proving!

7th ODI fifty for Babar Azam! He wasn't really among the runs in Tests but with the colored clothing he's back doing what he does best and how! With a responsible knock! Dananjaya bowls it outside off, Azam punches it through covers for a brace. He already has 2 hundreds this year, can he notch up one more?
Akila Dananjaya is back on for another spell. He gets a change of ends.
This delivery is worked down the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fired around middle and leg, Malik turns it through mid-wicket and jogs back for a brace.
Azam turns this away in front of square on the leg side for a run.
Now he flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Hurled on the pads, flicked away to mid-wicket.
Now Shoaib goes back and works it round the corner for a run.

FOUR! Experience gets you runs which brings you ecstasy! Vandersay tosses this up just outside off, Malik watches the ball till the end and deftly places it to the right of the backward point fielder for a boundary. He did give a valiant chase but came second best.
Again Malik gets his bat nicely in front off the pads as he pushes the ball defensively towards the bowler.
This ball is punched towards mid-wicket for a single.
Now he plays it through covers for a single.
Floated around middle and leg, Malik gets his bat forward and blocks it nicely.
Loopy ball around off, driven towards covers.
Azam sweeps it straight to the fielder at short fine leg. He makes a half stop first but doesn't concede a run.
Flatter around off, driven to the fielder at long off for one run.
This is punched to long off for a run.
Malik pushes it towards covers for a run to get off the mark.
Driven through mid-off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Shoaib Malik is the next man in.

OUT! Very poor shot next ball! Hafeez has to walk back now. All this while he has been picking up the length early and also finding the gaps on the field, but on this occasion he falters. Vandersay bowls this shorter and quicker around middle, the batsman goes back to pull. But gets it only as far as wide long on. Perera runs to his right and easily takes the catch. The visitors are ecstatic as Hafeez is a good player of spin and could have hurt them had he stayed a bit longer.

Not Out! Hafeez makes a smart use of the review here! Vandersay tosses this in line of the stumps, Hafeez gets down to sweep but gets hit on the back thigh. The Lankans appeal and the umpire raises the dreaded finger. The confidence of the batsman is visible as he chooses to review immediately. The replays roll in. Snicko shows a spike as the ball passes the bat. The third umpire says that's enough to overturn the on-field call. Hafeez survives!
Big appeal and Hafeez is ruled out LBW. He immediately signals for the review. Looks to be a goner unless he has got an inside edge there.
This ball is cut to the point region.
Loopy ball around off, driven to covers.
This ball is driven to the fielder at covers.
Flatter around off, punched to long off for a run.
The ball has taken the inside edge of the bat and goes down the leg side.
Hafeez pushes it back towards the bowler.
Azam collects a run after flicking it through square leg.
This ball is turned round the corner.

DROPPED! Chandimal spills a chance! Azam the beneficiary! Siriwardana serves it short, Babar goes back to pull it over mid-wicket but finds the fielder there. Chandimal dives to his left but fails to cling on to that and spills the chance. How costly will this prove?
This ball is pushed defensively back to the bowler.

FOUR! Another proof of how sweetly Hafeez is hitting the ball today. This one is floated outside off, the batsman gets under it and lofts it over covers for a boundary. Spoils what was a good over till now.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up ball, driven through covers for a run.
Hafeez punches this ball to long off for a run.
This delivery is pushed tthrough covers for a run.
Flatter around off, cut towards point.
Another run taken after playing it to long off.
Flatter and quicker in line of the stumps, punched back to the bowler's right, who makes a stop.
Loopy ball around off, driven to covers.
Floated outside off, driven through covers nicely for a run.
Served in line of the stumps, pushed back towards the bowler.
This ball is flicked off his pads through mid-wicket for a run.
This ball is turned to the mid off fielder.
Another delivery around off that spins away. Hafeez looks to cut it but misses.
Vandersay floats it around off, Azam gets a leading edge towards covers as he looks to turn it away. One run taken.
Served in line of the stumps, played in front of square on the leg side for a run.
FOUR! And Hafeez continues to milk boundaries against spinners. It was shortish in line of the stumps, the batsman pulls it over mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence.
Looped up in line of the stumps, pushed towards covers.
This delivery is swept away through square leg for a run.
Flatter on the pads, turned round the corner.
This is served in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Hafeez is really looking in good flow today. Siriwardana fires it short in line of the stumps, Hafeez picks up the length early. He goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Begins with a flatter delivery on off, punched down to long on for a run.
Milinda Sirwardana to have a bowl now. The slower bowlers have been effective so far, getting some purchase off the track as well.
100 up for Pakistan! And this one has been quicker than the first. The ball is driven through mid on for a run.
This ball is pushed back towards the bowler.
Flatter wrong 'un around middle and leg, worked away through square leg for a run.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Quicker around off, driven through coves for a single.
Jaffa! Tossed up leg spinner around middle, the ball spins past the defensively poked bat of Hafeez. That ball wasn't too far from the off pole. Beautiful leg spin bowling.
Now he collects a single after knocking it to long on.
FOUR! Well played! Hafeez seems to have picked up the spin early! It was a floated up leg spinner around middle, the batsman charges down the track and lifts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Flatter around off, Azam goes back to play through covers for a run.
Straighter in line of the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for one run.
This ball is turned away through square leg for a run.
Dananjaya tosses this up around middle and leg, the ball spins in sharply. Azam plays it with the bat behind his pads. No run there.
Hafeez finds the cover fielder as he plays this.
This ball is pushed back towards the bowler.
Floated in line of the stumps, Azam goes back and works it through backwards square leg for a single.
Landed in line of the stumps, pushed back towards the bowler.
This time punched to the sweeper cover fielder for a single.
Loopy leg spinner around middle and off, Hafeez lunges forward to block that.
Very full outside off, finds the cover fielder with the drive.
A tad short outside off, Azam goes back and slaps it through cover-point for a brace.
Served fuller around off, driven through covers for a single.
Floated around off, a run taken after playing it to long off.
Landed fuller around off, driven wide of mid off for a run.
FOUR! Wonderfully swept! Dananjaya floats it around off, Hafeez fetches it from outside off and hits it through square leg for a boundary.
This ball is flicked away through square leg for a run. Hafeez gets going with that.
Flatter in line of the stumps, punched to long on for a run.
This ball is cut away towards backward point.
Floated around off, pushed towards mid off.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Vandersay tosses this around off, pushed towards covers.
Jeffrey Vandersay to have a bowl now.
This ball is punched back to the bower.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The experienced Mohammad Hafeez strides out to the middle. Pakistan would want him to use all his experience and score some useful runs for his side.

OUT! Knocked him over! It is not easy to keep a bowler with a bag full of tricks quiet! After being hit out of the ground on the previous ball, Dananjaya floats this flipper up around off. Zaman plays for the non-existent turn and ends up missing the ball completely, only to find his off stump shattered. He looks clueless and disappointed. Pakistan lose their second, this time a set batsman. The visitors are over the moon and they should be!
SIX! This is what Zaman tried to do a couple of balls ago but missed, doesn't miss out this time! Floated around middle, the batsman gets down and slogs it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Beaten! Slow loopy ball outside off, just spinning away. Fakhar looks to guide it but misses.
Akila tosses this up around off, Zaman looks to slog it away but ends up getting a bottom edge towards covers.
Perera lands it in line of the stumps, Zaman looks to flick it away but gets a leading edge towards covers for a run.
Bowled outside off, driven  towards covers for a run.
Worked off his pads through square leg for a run.

Good running! This is bowled in line of the stumps, Azam punches it towards mid on and sets off for a quick run. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but ends up hitting the stumps at the keeper's end. The batsman is safe though.
On a length around off, punched back towards the bowler.
Length delivery around off and middle, turned away past mid-wicket for a brace.

Drinks are on the field now. This has been a good hour of play for Pakistan as they have managed to carry on steadily in spite of the wicket that they lost. Sri Lanka won't be unhappy as they haven't let the opposition run away with the game. What would be hurting them is the fact that they have lost their lone review. They'd hope they won't need it hence.
Loopy ball in line of the stumps, driven down to long on for a run.
This delivery is hit back towards the bowler.
Landed around off, cut away to third man for a single.
50-run stand between Zaman and Azam! How comfortable have these two looked. Served in line of the stumps, Azam goes deep and flicks it away to fine leg for a run.
This is the flatter wrong 'un in line of the stumps, Azam is hurried on and inside edges it towards short fine leg.
Tossed up off spinner around off and middle, turning in to Azam. He goes back to cut but gets a bottom edge next to the pitch on the leg side.
Azam collects a run after playing this to the fielder at deep square leg.
Another delivery around off is pushed back towards the bowler.
WIDE! Perera sprays it down the leg side. Azam raises his bat and lets it go. Wide given.
This ball is pushed towards mid off.
On a length around off, punched back towards the bowler.
Landed around off, Fakhar plays it towards covers for one run.
On the pads, flicked away towards mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Delicately played! Dananjaya serves it a tad short around off, Zaman goes deep in the crease and cuts it to collect a boundary through third man.

A big appeal, to no avail! Dananjaya flights this in line of the stumps, Zaman gets down to reverse sweep that but ends up gloving it to the leg side. The bowler puts in a loud appeal thinking that the ball struck the batsman's pads.
Loopy ball outside off, left alone by Fakhar.
Tossed up leg spinner around off, Azam charges down and collects a run by playing it through mid off.
Tossed up ball around off and middle, driven to long off for a run.
This ball is punched through the off side for a run. 50 up for Pakistan with this!
FOUR! Free runs! Perera bowls it short around leg, Zaman looks to swivel and pull but gets a top edge that races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On the pads, flicked away in front of square for a run.
Bouncer in line of the stumps, ducked under by Azam.
FOUR! What a shot that! Beautiful! Perera lands it on a length around off and middle, Azam uses his wrists to flick it through mid-wicket and collect a boundary.
Begins with a short ball outside off, Zaman upper cuts it towards third man for a run.
All-rounder Thisara Perera is brought into the attack now.
Pushed towards mid on from the crease.
This ball is defended by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Floated in line of the stumps, turned towards mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter around leg, Azam gets the faintest of edges as the ball rolls towards fine leg. A couple of runs taken.
This ball is defended by the batsman by showing the full face of the bat off the front foot.

Not Out! The lone review wasted by Sri Lanka! And that too early in the game. Dananjaya bowls a slow loopy ball spinning down the leg side. Azam looks to flick but misses. However, Dickwella collects and puts in a confident appeal for a caught behind. The umpire doesn't seem interested in that and proceeds to signal a wide. Dickwella convinces his skipper to go upstairs. Tharanga does so. The Snicko doesn't spot any edge and so the fielding side end up losing their sole review. Wide ball stays!
A huge appeal by the Sri Lankan keeper for a delivery down the leg side. The umpire stays put. Lankans seem convinced and they decide to review this.
Powerplay 2 signaled. A maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle. Meanwhile, Akila Dananjaya is brought on to bowl.
This ball is punched towards covers.
Gamage bowls it on the pads, Azam turns it through backward square leg for three runs.

FOUR! Ahhh! The on drive is one of the more gracious shots to watch in this sport. And Azam played it to perfection on this occasion. It was a fuller delivery in line of the stumps, pushed down the ground past mid on for a boundary.
Bowled around off, pushed back towards he bowler.

Back of a length ball around middle and leg, Zaman looks to pull it but ends up getting it off the inner half towards deep backward square leg for a single. The batsman hasn't been able to bash deliveries away so far, and this is one such instance.
On a length around off, punched towards mid off.
WIDE! Gamage bangs it short down the leg side. No trouble for Zaman there who ducks and lets it go. The umpire has to stretch his arms there.

The Sri Lankan bowlers have done well to keep the Pakistan openers quiet. Zaman generally feeds on the width on offer and flies away with the score, but today he hasn't been offered much by the seamers so far.
Short delivery around off, pulled away to the fielder at deep square leg for a run.
Pushed around middle and leg, Azam flicks it away through backward square leg for a run.
Lucky Zaman, as that could have easily gone onto the stumps! On a length outside off, the ball is angled in to the batsman. Zaman ends up chopping it away towards point. A run taken.
Fuller outside off, driven to the cover fielder.
WIDE! In a bid to cramp Zaman for room, Lakmal ends up spraying it down the leg side. Wide given.
This ball is around off and middle, punched towards covers.

Well bowled! Lakmal runs in from round the wicket and bowls it very full around leg. Zaman digs it out towards square leg off the inner half of his bat. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end as the non-striker ventured out in search of a run. The ball strikes him. No harm done though.
Very full ball around off, Azam digs it out towards the off side.
Another length delivery around off, Azam punches it to the fielder at mid off.
On a length at 144 kmph, flicked towards mid on.
That made a nice sound as Azam played that. No run though. It was fuller outside off, driven to mid of.
Bowled outside off, Azam defends it off the front foot towards covers.
Slower full delivery around middle and leg, Zaman turns it in front of square and crosses over for a singe.
Fuller ball outside off, left alone by Babar.
This is an off cutter on off, Zaman pushes it towards mid off and takes a single.
Again Azam opens the face of his bat and collects one run towards third man.
Very good fielding effort there by Dananjaya! Landed in line of the stumps, Azam flicks it towards mid-wicket where Akila makes a diving stop. Zaman wanted a run there but had to change his mind.
Suranga bowls this well outside off, Azam covers his stumps to shoulder arms. The on-air commentators are talking about a scoring opportunity missed there, as there was width on offer.
Lakmal lands it a tad fuller outside off, Azam defends it from the crease.

FOUR! That's the Zaman that we all know! Gamage bowls it on a length around middle and off, the batsman charges down the track and smashes it past mid off for a boundary. The ball wasn't too far from Azam's head at the other end!
Fuller around middle and leg, driven towards mid on. Zaman checked his stroke on seeing the inswing there.
This is bowled around off, Fakhar stands on the back foot and slaps it to mid off.
Lahiru bowls this on a length around middle and leg, Zaman pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Azam puts his weight on the back foot and cuts it towards third man for a run.
Gamage runs in and hurls it outside off. Azam camps back and plays it to backward point.
This ball is pushed to the off side from the crease.
Suranga lands it outside off, the ball shapes away a bit. Azam lets the ball come onto him and opens the face of the bat to collect a run to third man. Gets off the mark with that.
This ball is punched to the cover fielder.
Two slips for Azam.
Lakmal again bowls it in the line of the stumps, Zaman looks to turn it towards mid on. Gets a leading edge past a leaping backward point for a single.
This ball is landed on a length around off and middle, played defensively towards mid on.
One slip in place now. The second slip fielder has been moved to mid-wicket.
Bowled on the pads, flicked through backward square leg for a brace.
Bowled around off, pushed towards covers.
Babar Azam walks in at the fall of the first wicket. He is having a good time with white-ball cricket.

OUT! Shehzad departs for a 12-ball duck! What a terrible waste of a wicket that is! Gamage bowls it around off and middle, Shehzad gets fidgety as he was yet to get off the mark. Looks to get down the track and go over mid-wicket but the bat turns in his hands and he ends up spooning a simple catch towards square leg where Dananjaya makes no mistake. The bowler is ecstatic and why not. Early strike for Sri Lanka!
This ball around off is played defensively from the crease.
A quick run, completed comfortably! It is bowled around middle and leg, Fakhar plays it towards square leg and sets off for a run. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Around middle, Zaman shows the full bat ace as he plays it defensively towards the bowler.
Gamage bowls it on a length around middle and leg, turned away to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Landed around off, pushed towards point.
Lakmal comes round the wicket and lands it around off and middle. Zaman taps it towards square leg and sets off for a quick run.
Field change. The short fine leg fielder comes to mid-wicket and the deep square leg fielder goes to fine leg.

FOUR! First boundary of the game! Not the greatest delivery that Lakmal has bowled as yet. It was bowled on the pads, Zaman flicks it away and collects a boundary as the ball beats the short fine leg fielder.
Landed around off, looking at the width on offer, Zaman punches it towards covers. Thirimanne there dives to stop that.
Similar delivery around leg, this time Fakhar presents the full face of the bat as he taps it to the leg side.

A big appeal, turned down! Lakmal spears it fuller around leg, the ball swings in to the batsman. Zaman looks to flick but misses and wears it on the pads. The players appeal to no avail. Sliding down leg surely!
Ends well! Bowls it on a length in line of the stumps, punched back towards the bowler. Gamage has bowled well apart from conceding runs off his first ball.
Hurled around middle, turned away to the fielder at mid-wicket.
A tad fuller around off, Shehzad punches it towards covers.
On a length around off, Shehzad pushes it towards mid-wicket. Thinks of a run initially but then decides against it.
Landed around off, Shehzad plays it from the crease showing the full face of the bat.
Short and wide, easy runs collected! Zaman stays in the crease and cuts it in front of square on the off side. The batsmen run three as the fielder chases the ball down to retrieve it.
Lahiru Gamage to bowl with the second new ball. Two slips in place for him.
Beaten! It is a length ball outside off, Shehzad looks to poke at that from the crease. The ball moves away a tad to beat the edge of the bat. A good start for Sri Lanka with the ball.
Bowled well outside off, Shehzad shoulders arms to let the ball go.
Full around middle and off, flicked away to the fielder at mid-wicket.
On a length around off, a bit of shape away from the batsman. Shehzad gets behind that and blocks it from the crease.
First run for Zaman and Pakistan! This is landed in line of the stumps, flicked away towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a quick single.
WIDE! Moves away from his radar! Lakmal sprays this down the leg side, the ball swings away further. Zaman looks to flick but misses. Wide signaled.
Lakmal starts from over the wicket and hurls it full around off and middle, pushed back towards the bowler.

We are all set to get underway. Ahmed Shehzad and Fakhar Zaman walk out with the bat in hand. Giving Pakistan an explosive start would be in their minds. Suranga Lakmal will run in with the first new ball for Sri Lanka. An early strike is what he would aim for. Two slips in place. Let's roll...

Sri Lanka Playing XI - Niroshan Dickwella(wk), Upul Tharanga(c), Lahiru Thirimanne, Kusal Mendis, Dinesh Chandimal, Milinda Siriwardana, Thisara Perera, Suranga Lakmal, Jeffrey Vandersay, Akila Dananjaya, Lahiru Gamage
Pakistan Playing XI - Ahmed Shehzad, Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam, Shoaib Malik, Mohammad Hafeez, Sarfraz Ahmed (c/wk), Imad Wasim, Rumman Raees, Shadab Khan, Hasan Ali, Junaid Khan
TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to field.

Hello everybody! It's time for the white-ball cricket to get rolling. Welcome to our coverage for the first ODI between Pakistan and Sri Lanka from the Dubai International Cricket Stadium. The tourists would love to erase the memories from the series against India and look to carry forward their form from the Tests here. The hosts, on the other hand, are playing their first ODI since the Champions Trophy and they would look to begin on a positive note as well. Stay with us, for what promises to be a high-octane clash of the two Asian sides.
